scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
Diamonds...!
I simply can't get my mind off
them! Ever since that man
showed me that diamond,
it's been all I think about!
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
鑽石...！
我滿腦子都是鑽石，怎麼也忘不掉！
自從那個男人給我看了那顆鑽石，我就再也想不了別的了！

scripts.text: Would you like to have mine?
scripts.translation: 要不要我的鑽石

scripts.text: Ah, what a shame...
scripts.translation: 啊，真可惜...

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
Yes, I know...
Even among everything
in my collections, nothing
compares to diamonds...
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
是啊，我知道...
我所有的收藏裡，都沒有什麼能比得上鑽石...

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
*piff*
You don't have any diamonds!
Don't even try to fool me!
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
*piff*
你根本沒有鑽石！
別想騙我！

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
Are you sure you don't mind
giving this to me? Thank you
so much! I don't have much in
the way of money, but i can give
you something from one of my
collections~
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
你真的願意把它給我嗎？
太感謝了！
我沒什麼錢，不過可以送你一件收藏品~

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
Errr...
You brought too many things.
You can't receive this item now.
You better reorganize your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
Errr...
你帶的東西太多了，現在拿不了這件物品。
先整理一下物品欄再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
So what would
you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
那麼，你想要哪一類？

scripts.text: Weapon
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Garment
scripts.translation: 披肩

scripts.text: Helmet
scripts.translation: 頭盔

scripts.text: Shoes
scripts.translation: 鞋子

scripts.text: Shield
scripts.translation: 盾牌

scripts.text:
[Kachua]
Ah~ that Diamond is so beautiful.
I wish I could repay you better.
scripts.translation:
[卡楚阿]
啊~那顆鑽石真美。
我真希望能更好地報答你。

scripts.text:
[Devellin]
It seems some traveller showed
a huge diamond to Kachua a while ago. Ever since then, all she's been talking about is diamonds and how much she wants them.
scripts.translation:
[德維林]
好像前陣子有個旅人給卡楚阿看了一顆很大的鑽石。
從那以後，她就只會唸叨鑽石，還有自己多麼想要鑽石。

scripts.text:
[Devellin]
She's been getting pretty obsessive about it, which scares me. It seems she's more than willing to sacrifice anything she owns for a diamond.
scripts.translation:
[德維林]
她對鑽石越來越痴迷，真讓我害怕。
看來只要能換到鑽石，她什麼都願意捨棄。

scripts.text:
[Devellin]
She's the type of person who'll do anything to get what she wants. I'm worried that she might give away something far more valuable than a diamond in exchange...
scripts.translation:
[德維林]
她為了得到想要的東西，什麼都做得出來。
我擔心她會拿比鑽石貴重得多的東西去換...

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Heeeey...
It seems we share the same line of work, you and me. Heh heh, lemme give you a hot tip.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
Heeeey...
看來你我算是同行。
Heh heh，讓我給你透露個內幕訊息。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
I've been charging other people for this information, but since, shall we say, we work in the same professional field, I don't have the heart to take your zeny.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
這訊息我賣給別人都要收錢，不過既然咱們算是同行，我就不忍心收你的Zeny了。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
You see that lady over there?
She's just totally in love with diamonds. And from what my sources tell me, she's loaded. Tons and tons of valuables.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
看到那邊那位女士了嗎？
她對鑽石簡直著了迷。
據我的線人說，她家底可厚了，貴重物品多得數不清。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
I'm talkin' rare items.
I took the liberty of sneaking a peek at what she owns, and saw she's got a helmet with goat horns and even a crown! She's so rich it's ridiculous!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
我說的可是稀有物品。
我偷偷看過她的收藏，有一頂帶山羊角的頭盔，居然還有王冠！
她富得簡直不像話！

scripts.text:
[Cain]
The buzz that's been going around is that she's got a cache of rare equipment and weapons too! So whaddya say? Wanna be partners in crime and rob her house?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
聽說她還藏著一大批稀有裝備和武器！
怎麼樣，要不要跟我合夥，去搶她家？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Sweet, I'm in!
scripts.translation: 好極了，我加入

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Wha...?
C'mon! I thought pilfering was something you do! Aw well, I'm gonna do it, but stay hushed on this, got it?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
什...什麼？
拜託！我還以為偷東西是你的拿手好戲呢！
算了，我自己去，不過這事得保密，懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Ha ha ha!
...^660000Dork^000000!
I'm just jivin'
sp fuggedabout it!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
Ha ha ha!
...^660000笨蛋^000000！
逗你玩的，別當真！

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Ah right. Supposedly, there's a mountain where tons of diamonds are buried. A pal o' mine says there's a mine near the mountain too, so I guess if you went to the mine, you'd find Diamonds.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
啊，對了，聽說有座山埋著大量鑽石。
我有個朋友說，山附近還有個礦場，去那裡應該能找到鑽石。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
I guess it can't hurt to gather some Diamonds there and try to exchange them for whatever the old lady's got. Take care, pal~
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
去那裡弄點鑽石，再跟那位老太太換些東西，總歸不虧。
保重，朋友~

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Hey...
I got a hot tip for you.
It'll just cost you 500 zeny
and trust me, it's worth it.
So whaddya say...?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
嘿...
我有個內幕訊息告訴你。
只要500 Zeny，相信我，絕對值這個價。
怎麼樣...？

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Cain]
You see that lady over there? She's just totally in love with diamonds. And from what my sources tell me, she's loaded. Tons and tons of valuables.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
看到那邊那位女士了嗎？
她對鑽石簡直著了迷。
據我的線人說，她家底可厚了，貴重物品多得數不清。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
I'm talkin' rare items.
I took the liberty of sneaking a peek at what she owns, and saw she's got a helmet with goat horns and even a crown! She's so rich it's ridiculous!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
我說的可是稀有物品。
我偷偷看過她的收藏，有一頂帶山羊角的頭盔，居然還有王冠！
她富得簡直不像話！

scripts.text:
[Cain]
There's a chance that rare equipment and weapons might be yours! She'll give anything for a 3 carat diamond. So if you have any of those, you might as well see her.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
那些稀有裝備和武器，說不定就能歸你了！
只要給她一顆3克拉鑽石，她什麼都肯拿來換。
你要是有，不妨去找她。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Ah right. Supposedly, there's a mountain where tons of diamonds
are buried. A pal o' mine says there's a mine near the mountain too, so I guess if you went to the mine, you'd find Diamonds.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
啊，對了，聽說有座山埋著大量鑽石。
我有個朋友說，山附近還有個礦場，去那裡應該能找到鑽石。

scripts.text:
[Cain]
I guess it can't hurt to gather some Diamonds there and try to exchange them for whatever the old lady's got. Take care, pal~
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
去那裡弄點鑽石，再跟那位老太太換些東西，總歸不虧。
保重，朋友~

scripts.text:
[Cain]
What the hell?!
Don't you have any money? Didn't I say 500 zeny? Hey man, info like this doesn't come cheap!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
搞什麼鬼？！
你沒錢嗎？我不是說了要500 Zeny？
這種訊息可不便宜！

scripts.text:
[Cain]
Hey hey!
What are you, a cheapskate? You understand that everything has its price and this information is so worth it. C'mon, you can't pass this up, can you?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
嘿，嘿！
你是吝嗇鬼嗎？
什麼東西都有價錢，這訊息絕對值這個價。
拜託，這種機會你捨得錯過？

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Wahahahaha~
I've dug up a fortune!
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
Wahahahaha~
我挖到一大筆財富了！

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Diamonds! Hundreds and
thousands of Diamonds,
all of them mine!
I'm rich!
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
鑽石！成百上千顆鑽石，全都是我的！
我發財了！

scripts.text: I want to buy some.
scripts.translation: 我想買一些

scripts.text: Congratulations.
scripts.translation: 恭喜

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Ah, you have an
eye for valuables!
Sure, sure why not!
I'll give you a discount, too!
55,000 Zeny for a diamond,
how does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
啊，你很識貨嘛！
當然，當然，沒問題！
我還給你打個折！
一顆鑽石55,000 Zeny，怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
How many
diamonds do you need?
If you change your mind,
please enter '0' to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
你要多少顆鑽石？
改變主意的話，輸入“0”取消。

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Alright, you've
canceled the trade.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
好的，你取消了交易。
再見！

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
The maximum
amount is 500.
Please enter 500 or less.
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
最多隻能買500顆。
請輸入不超過500的數量。

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Errr...
I'm sorry, but you
do not have enough money.
I'll be losing money if
I sell them at that price.
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
Errr...
抱歉，你的錢不夠。
照那個價錢賣，我可要虧本了。

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Errr...
You're carrying too many items.
I don't think give you anything if there's no room in your inventory. Why don't you put some of your stuff into Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
Errr...
你帶的東西太多了，物品欄沒空位，我可沒法把東西給你。
先存些東西到卡普拉倉庫怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Thank you for
buying my diamonds!
You're welcome to
come back anytime.
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
謝謝你購買我的鑽石！
歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Dwayne]
Haha, thank you~
If by any chance
you need a diamond,
please drop by.
I'll sell them to
you at a cheap price.
scripts.translation:
[德韋恩]
Haha，謝謝~
要是需要鑽石，隨時來找我。
我會便宜賣給你的。
